title: Tool contract spec: JSON shapes, validation flow, and human-friendly error semantics
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: unify JSON schema contract + runtime validation for function/tool calling. Goals: (1) machine-verifiable contracts across SDKs/runtime, (2) lenient and strict validation modes, (3) deterministic, developer-friendly error objects that UIs and automation can consume. Also provide migration guidance for older integrations.
validation_pipeline: Stages: 1) parse: attempt JSON parse, return parse_failure on invalid JSON. 2) coerce: if x-redwood-coerce enabled, coerce common types ("10.5" -> number) and annotate changes. 3) schema validation: run restricted JSON Schema 2020-12 subset; obey x-redwood-strict-additional for additionalProperties. 4) canonicalize: reorder keys per x-redwood-paramOrder and produce canonical object for runtime. Each stage emits structured diagnostics and a correlation_id for cross-service tracing.
error_model_summary: Stable flat error object per validation issue. Fields: error_code (enum), parameter_path (JSON Pointer), expected (short summary), received (short repr), message (human display English), hint (optional remediation), documentation_url, correlation_id. Error codes: invalid_parameters, missing_required, type_mismatch, additional_properties, enum_mismatch, parse_failure, schema_internal, validation_timeout.
example_error_payload:
{
  "error_code": "type_mismatch",
  "parameter_path": "/amount",
  "expected": "number >= 0",
  "received": ""10.50" (string)",
  "message": "Parameter 'amount' must be a non-negative number. We received a string.",
  "hint": "Send amount as a numeric value (e.g. 10.5) or enable coercion on the contract.",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.redwood.com/api/validation",
  "correlation_id": "op_3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
}
migration_notes: Backwards compatibility: existing function contracts without x-redwood-* extensions default to x-redwood-coerce=off and x-redwood-strict-additional=false. Provide a one-week deprecation window for customers who opt into strict-additional via header. Publish a script and lint rule to annotate old contracts with recommended extensions.
